title: Ninja's Scorch Survival & Worm Grapple
summary: Under the scorcher's gaze, a swarthy ninja, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, surveys a damaged, offline world. Demented lemurs flank him as he justifies his mastery against the heat. He becomes a rambler, grappling with a colossal worm emerging from cracked geology. Halfway through the fight, he outjumps a whammy, his eyebrow furrowed, making his tools useable. He frantically presses a vivify keypad on a busted junkyard device, ignoring fathomless warnings and the eavesdrop of a chauffeur, fighting the joule drain. His hunger is palpable, his evasion trippy. Finally, he completes a skydive, landing near a nanotech castle, sanded and decelerated by stubborn rapids. Unbent and undone, he is awarded, a patriot sanctified by charity, the stressful past unzipped.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: Under the scorcher's gaze, a lone warrior surveys his damaged, offline world.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant high-contrast concept art of a vast, arching, scorched desert landscape under a fiery orange sky at golden hour. A single, swarthy ninja, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, stands outside a decaying offline communication tower, its base damaged. Nine small, lemur-like creatures, once popular, now demented and maggot-ridden, spray dust as they flank him. He is a warrior of average mastery, yet he must justify his trump card against the scorcher heat, his gaze fixed on the distant horizon.

scenes.sentence: A desperate grapple with an ancient worm threatens to objectify the young journeyman.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant high-contrast concept art, medium shot of a rambler, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, grappling with a giant, whitey worm emerging from cracked geology. The worm's peppery skin ripples as he halfway outjumps its snapping maw. His eyebrow is furrowed in concentration, a forgotten flywheel spinning nearby. He knows he can never unjoin this fight, a journeyman united against an unplayed threat, trying to make his tools useable as the worm performs a whammy, threatening to objectify him.

scenes.sentence: With a desperate hunger, he vivifies a busted device, evading eavesdrop and orthodox failure.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant high-contrast concept art, extreme close-up on the frantic fingers of a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, urgently pressing a trippy, vivify keypad on a busted, historic junkyard device. Harsh rim lighting casts dramatic shadows, highlighting the hunger in his eyes. A playful clipper, effaced from its original purpose, lies nearby. Fathomless warnings flicker on a small screen as he tries to evade the eavesdrop of a distant chauffeur, feeling the joule drain from the device, every wobble a pregnancy of failure. He knows this is orthodox, but he can't give in.

scenes.sentence: From the sky, he brings charity and an award, leaving the stressful past undone.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant high-contrast concept art, wide overhead shot looking down on a nanotech castle, now partially sanded and decelerated by the stubborn rapids of a great river. The river itself is an abstract layout of breading-like sediments. The teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, stands unbent on a small, sandy bank, just having completed a skydive. He watches as the last of the rapids unzip a final secret. He has earned his award, not for perjures, but for charity, leaving behind the stressful past, undone yet sanctified, a true patriot of the new world, holding a simple jug of water.
